pearl-city-elevator.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 4 Pearl City Elevator locations, all of them in Illinois. The towns include Baileyville, Lena and Pearl City. The table carries bids for corn and soybeans at each spot, pulled from pce-coops.agricharts.com and rebuilt through the day.

poet-grain.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 19 POET Grain locations across 7 states. Iowa has 10 of them, including Arthur, Coon Rapids, Emmetsburg and Gowrie, and Minnesota has 3 at Albert Lea, Bingham Lake and Lake Crystal. Ohio has 2, with 1 each in Indiana, Michigan, Nebraska and South Dakota, and the table carries corn and soybeans.

prairie-ag-partners.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 7 Prairie Ag Partners locations, all of them in South Dakota. The towns include Arlington, Badger, Carthage, De Smet, Iroquois and Lake Preston. The table carries bids for corn, soybeans and wheat at each spot.

premier-cooperative.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 8 Premier Cooperative locations across 2 states, with 4 in Iowa and 4 in Wisconsin. On the Iowa side that includes Manchester, New Albin, Ossian and Postville, and in Wisconsin it runs through Mazomanie, Mineral Point, Richland Center and Westby. The table carries corn and soybeans at each spot.

premier-cooperative-il.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 23 Premier Cooperative - IL locations, all of them in Illinois. Towns on the list include Broadlands, Champaign, Collison, Dewey, Fairmount and Farmer City. The table carries bids for corn, soybeans and wheat at each spot.

premier-grain.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 4 Premier Grain locations, all 4 in Ohio. The towns are Jamestown, Sabina, South Salem and Wilmington. The table carries corn and soybeans at each one.

pro-cooperative.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 16 Pro Cooperative locations, and all 16 are in Iowa. The towns include Ayrshire, Bradgate, Eagle Grove, Emmetsburg, Gilmore City and Graettinger. The table carries corn and soybeans, and that is the whole list.
